problem: The boards have to be filled before ten and nobody told him
action: Early morning, just after sunrise, on the forecourt. A freestanding display board on a metal frame stands near the island — its face is a completely blank white panel. The dealer stands in front of it with a marker pen held up in his right hand, arm half-raised, not yet touching the board. He is looking at the blank surface the way you look at a job you have only just found out about.
lighting: Low golden sunrise light coming from behind the board so it is rim-lit, his face lit warmly from the side, long shadows stretching across the concrete towards camera.
camera: Waist-up, he is on the right of the vertical frame in three-quarter profile and the blank board fills the left. Sharp on him. 35mm.
detail: CRITICAL — the board is entirely BLANK white. No writing, no columns, no ruling, no headings, no numbers, no letters, no logos, nothing at all on its surface. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: The morning pressure of a job with a deadline you learned about too late.
motion: His raised hand with the marker lowers very slightly, hesitating. A slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: स्टॉक बोर्ड, निरीक्षण शीट — सुबह दस बजे से पहले। ये कौन बताता?
